newsitem.title: USA: AUTO SALES IN U.S. GAIN 11.7 PCT AUGUST 1-10 - CNW.
newsitem.headline: AUTO SALES IN U.S. GAIN 11.7 PCT AUGUST 1-10 - CNW.

text.p: Auto sales in the United States rose 11.7 percent August 1-10 compared with the same period a year ago, according to a report by CNW Marketing/Research.
During the survey period, sales of domestic autos rose 12.0 percent, and U.S. sales of imports rose 10.2 percent.
Specifically, domestic car sales rose 14.9 percent to 136,894 from 119,166, CNW said. Domestic truck sales rose 8.8 percent to 119,564 from 109,851, it said.
Import car sales advanced 11.9 percent to 33,222 while import truck sales rose 3.4 percent to 8,022, the report said.
Year-to-date vehicle sales in the United States reached 9,292,064, off 2.9 percent from the same period of 1996, according to CNW.
